note: Rules the scraper uses to find supermarket products for each recipe ingredient. 'include' is a list of groups: a product must contain at least one word from EVERY group. 'exclude' words rule a product out. base is g, ml or ea (each). units converts recipe units to the base amount. pantry=true means the site assumes you already own it. fresh=true only takes products from a fresh produce aisle. by_weight=true ignores products sold by count (a bunch of bananas is not one banana). g_or_ml=true treats grams and millilitres as equal (sauces are sold both ways). The scraper also skips products named with words like sauce, powder or snack (NOT_INGREDIENT in scraper.py) unless the ingredient's include words or its 'allow' list name them.
